explanation: Because the small NLI model is heavily overconfident when predicting INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE on complex enterprise contradictions, the Confidence Gate (< 0.90) never triggers (0% recall). Consequently, the Selective LLM Adjudicator is never invoked (invocation rate = 0%). This mathematically forces the NLI_SELECTIVE_LLM architecture to behave identically to NLI_ONLY, meaning the action engine produces the exact same failure patterns.
